summary: A Trading Economics page on the United States Fed Funds interest rate, centered on the Federal Reserve's March 2024 decision to hold the rate at 5.25%-5.5%, its fifth consecutive hold. The page also summarizes the updated Fed projections (rate cuts, GDP, PCE inflation, unemployment), the upcoming calendar, key related indicators, and how US interest rate authority is split between the Board and the FOMC. Navigation, subscription and footer boilerplate is ignored.
one_line: Trading Economics overview of the US Fed Funds rate, held at 5.25%-5.5% in March 2024 with projections for three cuts in 2024.
key_facts: The Federal Reserve left the fed funds rate steady at a 23-year high of 5.25%-5.5% for a fifth consecutive meeting in March 2024.
The Federal Reserve's March 2024 decision was in line with market expectations.
Policymakers still planned three interest rate cuts in 2024, similar to the quarterly forecasts in December.
The Fed's March 2024 projections indicated three rate cuts in 2025, one fewer than in December, plus three more reductions in 2026.
Projected US GDP growth for 2024 was 2.1%, up from 1.4% in the December projection.
Projected core PCE inflation for 2024 was raised to 2.6% from 2.4%.
The unemployment rate was projected at 4% in 2024, versus 4.1% previously, and kept at 4.1% for 2025.
The Fed Interest Rate was 5.50 percent as of March 2024, and the Unemployment Rate was 3.80 percent as of March 2024.
Inflation Rate YoY was 3.20 percent as of February 2024.
The Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve decides on changes in discount rates after recommendations from regional Federal Reserve Banks.
The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) decides on open market operations, including the desired federal funds market rate.
The US fed funds rate series has data from 1971 to 2024 with a highest value of 20.00 and a lowest value of 0.25 percent, reported daily.
Fed Chair Powell said at the San Francisco Fed that PCE inflation data for February was more along the lines of what the Fed wants to see.
Upcoming calendar items include the Fed Beige Book on 2024-04-17 and the Fed Interest Rate Decision on 2024-05-01 with consensus at 5.5%.
